=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:48-404 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The inventory has no roster bullet for `.github/workflows/ci_pr_quick.yml`, `scripts/ci_docs_only_paths.sh`, `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` or `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, although all four exist on this ref and README.md:156-158 plus agents.md:1294/2094/2096/2115 reference them.
  WHY: `python3 tests/inventory_parity.py` fails in the `tests-release-and-log-analysis` CI job (11 FAIL lines, exit 1), so the aggregate `lint` job fails with "CI jobs that did not succeed: tests-release-and-log-analysis" and the merge is blocked; all reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/review_autofix_sweep_reaper.sh:56-183 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The P11b zombie reaper is on by default (`${ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED:-true}` at line 56), but cancel and force-cancel both return 409 for the wedged queued runs it targets (run 43095142301). The helper picks the oldest runs first (line 116) and keeps no record of failed attempts, so every tick selects the same runs again.
  WHY: Every 30-minute sweep makes up to 20 Actions write calls that cannot succeed and logs `ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPED ... result=failed` for the same run ids forever, while later runs are starved; the owner's requested default-`false` change (including tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zombie_reaper.py:381 and the P11b fragments) is not applied. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:223-533 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow turns the reaper on by default (`ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED: ${{ vars.ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED || 'true' }}` at line 223, with case guards at lines 265/533) and hands `github.token` with `actions: write` (lines 223-225) to a helper that cannot clear any of its targets.
  WHY: Every consumer repo runs failing Actions writes on every tick by default, and the only kill switch is an operator-set repo variable; the fix is the same single default flip as the helper finding. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:307-658 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR` is used at lines 307, 345, 360, 402, 634 and 658 without validation or existence checks.
  WHY: Gemini says that if the variable is unset, or points to a missing or malicious directory, execution fails or runs untrusted code; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked and rejected this because line 7 always sets it to the script's own directory.
- .github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml:62-74 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The release-blocker reporter is on by default but depends on TG_BOT_SECRET and TG_ADMIN_CHAT_ID.
  WHY: Gemini says missing secrets could make release blockers go unreported (a silent release-gate failure); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this because the `TG_*` variables only feed a delivery-failure WARNING and the heal report goes through repository_dispatch (tg_helpers fail open).
- tests/test_support_script_single_source.py:444-565 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The contract test asserts the clarify host-Python directory holds exactly `stage_support_host_python_scripts`, but scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:124-126 and :341-344 now also copy the optional helpers (`evidence_pack.py targeted_file_context.py attempt_journal.py gh_api_retry.py`), and the fixture (lines 324-332) never stages them.
  WHY: The test invariant no longer describes the helper's behaviour and no test runs the new copy path; a fixture that stages the real helper set would turn the assertion red.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR title "remove stuck states (plan P2a-P13 remainder)"; plan phase P13: "Project security pass line ownership and rebinding. Implements docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md Phase A and Phase B exactly as written (two PRs, any order), fresh off `main`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh (Phase A: `advisory_findings`/`findings` split, `verified_fixed_finding_ids`, `counts.advisory` under `SECURITY_AUDIT_LINE_OWNERSHIP=project-lines`); scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh + .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (Phase B: `SECURITY_PASS_LINE_OWNERSHIP`, `SECURITY_PASS_OWNERSHIP_CONTEXT_LINES`, `security_pass_rebind_if_no_new_project_lines`, `SECURITY_PASS_REBOUND` / `SECURITY_PASS_VERIFIED_FIXED` log prefixes)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: A repo-wide grep for `SECURITY_PASS_REBOUND`, `verified_fixed_finding_ids`, `project-lines` and `security_pass_rebind_if_no_new_project_lines` matches only docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md and docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md. There is no p13 changelog.d or agents.d fragment, while P2a-P12 each have one. The live `SECURITY_AUDIT_LINE_OWNERSHIP=project` path (scripts/security_audit.sh:502, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9972-9995) implements a different plan's shape. The PR diff has no project-line ownership, advisory routing or rebinding implementation. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (likely delivered in separate PRs off main, so the title overstates scope); the others rated it MAJOR.
- requirement: Clearly document resolution status of P2a-P13 stuck-states in README.md/agents.md fragments.
  expected_change_site: README.md, agents.d/
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The README.md and agents.d/ documentation does not clearly show which stuck-states items are fully resolved and which still need manual intervention (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed this as wording-only, covered by the P13 gap).

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:"## Workflows" and "## Scripts" sections | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5

- scripts/review_autofix_sweep_reaper.sh:56 (callers .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 223, 265, 533; tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zombie_reaper.py line 381) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The P11b reaper is on by default, but cancel and force-cancel both return 409 for the wedged runs (run 43095142301, `jobs.total_count == 0`); it picks the oldest runs first and keeps no failure record. The owner's requested default-false change is not applied.
  WHY: Every 30-minute sweep makes up to 20 Actions write calls that cannot succeed and logs `ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPED ... result=failed` forever. Fix: default to `false` at those lines, change test line 381 to `'false'`, and update the P11b fragments.
- Checked and rejected: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh lines 311-312 unset `RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR` (line 7 always sets it); the auto-release-stable.yml Telegram claim (`TG_*` only feeds a WARNING; the heal report goes through repository_dispatch).
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: PR title "remove stuck states (plan P2a-P13 remainder)"; plan phase P13: "Project security pass line ownership and rebinding. Implements docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md Phase A and Phase B exactly as written (two PRs, any order), fresh off `main`."
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh (Phase A) and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh plus .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (Phase B: `security_pass_rebind_if_no_new_project_lines`, `SECURITY_PASS_REBOUND`).
  Evidence of absence: The grep matches only the two plan docs, and there is no p13 changelog.d/agents.d fragment; P13 is probably delivered outside this branch, so the title overstates scope.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Stage workflow support files" unified-branch `support_list_name` loop. Optional helpers in `--list` are added to scripts/.gitignore even when the bundle skipped them, whereas implement.yml filters by file presence (tests/test_support_script_single_source.py:663 only asserts a superset). Fix: read back `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` and apply the `-f`/`! -L` filter (~4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
